card: Updates the functional test framework to support setting `self.chain = "main"` rather than requiring tests to set `self.chain = ""` as a workaround. `TestNode.chain_dir` now maps `"main"` to an empty datadir subdirectory, and `write_config()` omits chain CLI arguments and section headers for mainnet. This is an internal test framework cleanup that eliminates an unintuitive convention noted during review of PR #34566.
evidence: Author notes the workaround cleanup was suggested during review: 'This was mentioned in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34566#discussion_r3667623302.'
problem: Mainnet data is stored in the root data directory rather than a chain-specific subdirectory, but `TestNode.chain_dir` previously assumed the datadir subpath matched the chain name. Mainnet tests had to work around this by setting `self.chain = ""`, diverging from standard chain naming used across the rest of the codebase.

risk.why: Only affects functional test framework datadir and config path resolution.

summary: Updates the Python test framework so tests can set `self.chain = "main"` instead of using the empty string workaround. Maps `"main"` to an empty subdirectory in `TestNode.chain_dir` and omits chain configuration flags in `write_config()`.
